description: SwiftUI extension for CronSettings, defining a View with various UI components for managing cron jobs, including header, content, scheduler banner, and detail views.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Defines the main view layout for CronSettings, including banner, header, content, and modal dialogs.

methods.name: schedulerBanner
methods.description: Displays a warning if the cron scheduler is disabled, along with related info.

methods.name: header
methods.description: Provides controls for refreshing jobs and creating a new job.

methods.name: content
methods.description: Displays the list of jobs, status/error messages, and a detail view for the selected job.

methods.name: detail
methods.description: Shows detailed info and run history for the selected job, or a prompt to select a job.
